params.desc: The text snippet to match inside member statuses.

subcommands.name: config
subcommands.description: shows current vanity tracker configuration for this server

moderation.label: Moderation
moderation.desc: Moderation suite: warnings, tempban/tempmute with background sweeper, ban, kick, and mod logs.

Moderation.name: ban
Moderation.description: Permanently bans a member from the server.

params.name: user
params.desc: Member or User ID to ban.

params.name: reason
params.desc: Reason for the ban.

Moderation.note: Requires Ban Members permission.

Moderation.name: clear
Moderation.description: Clears all active warnings and resets the penalty counter for a member.

params.name: user
params.desc: Member whose warnings should be cleared.

Moderation.note: Requires Administrator permission. This action cannot be undone.

Moderation.name: kick
Moderation.description: Kicks a member from the server.

params.name: user
params.desc: Member to kick.

params.name: reason
params.desc: Reason for the kick.

Moderation.note: Requires Kick Members permission.

Moderation.name: log
Moderation.description: Shows or sets the audit log channel where warning actions are broadcasted.

params.name: channel
params.desc: Channel to post warning logs to. Omit to view current channel.

Moderation.note: Requires Administrator or Manage Server permission.

Moderation.name: tempban
Moderation.description: Temporarily bans a member; automatically unbans when the timer expires.

params.name: user
params.desc: Member or User ID to temporarily ban.

params.name: duration
params.desc: Time duration (e.g. 10m, 2h, 7d).

params.name: reason
params.desc: Reason for the temporary ban.

Moderation.note: Persistent across bot reboots via background sweeper.

Moderation.name: timeout
Moderation.description: Times out / mutes a member for a specified duration.

params.name: user
params.desc: Member to timeout.

params.name: duration
params.desc: Duration (e.g. 5m, 1h, 7d). Max 28 days.

params.name: reason
params.desc: Reason for the timeout.

Moderation.note: Requires Moderate Members permission.

Moderation.name: unban
Moderation.description: Unbans a user by ID.

params.name: user_id
params.desc: Discord ID of the banned user.

params.name: reason
params.desc: Reason for the unban.

Moderation.note: Requires Ban Members permission.

Moderation.name: untimeout
Moderation.description: Removes timeout / mute from a member.

params.name: user
params.desc: Member to untimeout.

params.name: reason
params.desc: Reason for lifting timeout.

Moderation.note: Requires Moderate Members permission.

Moderation.name: unwarn
Moderation.description: Removes the most recent warning from a member.

params.name: user
params.desc: Member to remove latest warning from.

Moderation.note: Requires Administrator or Moderate Members permission.

Moderation.name: warn
Moderation.description: Warns a member with automatic progressive penalties (3 warns = 1h timeout, 5 warns = ban).

params.name: user
params.desc: Member to issue a warning to.

params.name: reason
params.desc: Reason for the warning.

Moderation.note: Requires Administrator or Moderate Members permission. Use `.warn log #channel` to configure staff logs.
